Operator:
Good day, and welcome to the InnovateCloud Q3 2024 Earnings Conference Call. All participants are in listen-only mode. After the speakers' presentation, there will be a question and answer session. [Operator Instructions] Please be advised that today's call is being recorded.

I would now like to turn the call over to Alex Jones, Investor Relations Manager. Please go ahead.

Alex Jones:
Thank you, Operator. Good afternoon, everyone, and welcome to InnovateCloud's Q3 2024 earnings call. Joining me today are Michael Lee, CEO; Sarah Chen, CFO; David Rodriguez, CTO; Emily Carter, Chief Revenue Officer; and Brian Kim, Chief Product Officer.

Before we begin, I'd like to remind you that this call contains forward-looking statements. Actual results may differ materially. Please refer to our SEC filings for a complete discussion of risks and uncertainties.

Now, I'll turn the call over to Michael Lee.

Michael Lee:
Thank you, Alex, and good afternoon, everyone. I'm pleased to report on InnovateCloud's performance for Q3 2024. We achieved significant milestones this quarter, driven by strong demand for our FlowState low-code automation platform and continued execution of our strategic initiatives.

Our focus this quarter was on six key areas: sales efficiency, key assumptions underlying guidance, free cash flow, NRR performance, average contract value, and capital allocation.

Okay, let's dive into sales efficiency, focusing on sales cycle length and conversion rates. This is a critical area for understanding the health and scalability of our revenue engine, and I want to provide a detailed view of our performance, the factors influencing it, and the initiatives we're implementing to drive further improvements.

Our average sales cycle length for SynergySuite, our cloud-based enterprise resource planning (ERP) platform targeted at mid-sized manufacturing companies, in Q3 was 92 days, representing a 5% decrease compared to 97 days in Q2 and a 10% decrease compared to Q3 of last year, which was 102 days. This positive trend is a result of several strategic initiatives that Emily will detail later.

Breaking this down further, for SMBs, the average sales cycle is 65 days, down from 70 days last quarter. Mid-Market sales cycles average 95 days, while Enterprise deals, while still a small segment for us, take the longest at 140 days. Regionally, North America remains our most efficient region with an average sales cycle of 88 days. EMEA sales cycles are slightly longer at 98 days, and APAC presents the longest at 110 days.

Our overall lead-to-customer conversion rate for SynergySuite in Q3 is 12%, a slight improvement of 1 percentage point from 11% in Q2. Specifically, our Marketing Qualified Lead (MQL) to Sales Accepted Lead (SAL) conversion rate is 35%. SAL to Sales Qualified Lead (SQL) is 55%. SQL to Opportunity is 60%, and Opportunity to Closed Won is 36%. The SMB segment enjoys the highest conversion rate at 15%, while Mid-Market is 11%, and Enterprise stands at 8%. North America leads with a 13% conversion rate, EMEA is 11%, and APAC is 9%.

To improve both sales cycle length and conversion rates, we are rolling out a new Sales Enablement Platform, based on the SalesLoft and Highspot models, which will provide our sales team with readily accessible, up-to-date content, automated workflows, and improved training resources. We've integrated AI-powered lead scoring into our Marketo instance. We've invested in creating more interactive and personalized product demos using tools like Demostack. We are actively expanding our partner network, particularly in EMEA and APAC. We are creating targeted content that addresses the specific pain points of key verticals within the manufacturing sector. And for SMB customers, we've significantly streamlined the onboarding process.

Okay, let's dive into the key assumptions underpinning our guidance for the upcoming fiscal year, and the next three years, as we laid out in the presentation. Our guidance is built upon a foundation of continued macroeconomic uncertainty, with a conservative outlook for global GDP growth. We are factoring in potential headwinds from persistent inflation, rising interest rates, and regional geopolitical tensions.

We project a 15% year-over-year increase in new customer acquisition for our core 'SynergySuite' platform. This 15% growth is further broken down by region: North America, we anticipate 12% growth; EMEA, we are forecasting 18% growth; APAC, we are projecting the highest growth rate at 22%. The NCA assumption is heavily reliant on the successful rollout of our enhanced self-service onboarding experience, powered by AI chatbot support, scheduled for Q2. To mitigate the risk of not meeting our NCA targets, we are piloting a new freemium model for smaller businesses.

We are projecting a continued strong NRR of 118%. A significant driver of NRR is our success in upselling customers to our 'SynergySuite Enterprise' tier. We are also assuming a 15% adoption rate for our new 'SynergyAI' module. Our churn assumption remains conservative at 5% annually. To further improve NRR, we are developing a predictive churn model that uses machine learning to identify customers at risk of churning. As a hedge against churn, we're building out a value-based pricing model.

We are projecting a 8% year-over-year increase in ARPA, driven by a combination of price increases, upselling, and the adoption of add-on modules. We are implementing a modest price increase of 3% across all subscription tiers, effective Q2.

We are projecting a 12% increase in operating expenses, primarily driven by investments in sales and marketing, research and development (R&D), and personnel costs. We are increasing our sales and marketing spend by 15% to support our NCA targets and expand our market reach. We are increasing our R&D spend by 10% to continue innovating and developing new features and functionalities for our platform. We are projecting a 10% increase in personnel costs, driven by hiring and wage inflation.

We are actively exploring strategic acquisitions to expand our product portfolio and enter new markets. We are investing heavily in our partner ecosystem to expand our reach and leverage the expertise of third-party integrators and consultants. We are committed to delivering exceptional customer service and support.

We are confident in our ability to continue this momentum and deliver long-term value to our shareholders.

Now, I'll turn the call over to Sarah Chen to discuss the financials in more detail.

Sarah Chen:
Thank you, Michael. As Michael mentioned, we had a strong quarter. Revenue for the quarter was $680 million, representing a 25% increase year-over-year. Our gross margin was 75%, and operating income was $150 million.

We continue to invest in research and development to drive innovation and expand our product offerings. Our cash position remains strong, providing us with the flexibility to pursue strategic acquisitions and other growth opportunities.

In Q3 2024, InnovateCloud generated $75 million in Free Cash Flow (FCF). This represents a 15% increase compared to the $65 million generated in Q3 2023, and a healthy 11% FCF margin based on our Q3 revenue of $680 million. This improvement is a testament to our disciplined operating model and strategic investments in key areas that drive both revenue and efficiency.

Our revenue growth, primarily driven by our flagship SaaS product, "SynergySuite," continues to be a significant contributor. SynergySuite's robust ARR (Annual Recurring Revenue) of $500 million, representing a 25% YoY growth, provides a stable and predictable cash flow stream. We are seeing particularly strong growth in the EMEA region, attributed to the successful localization of SynergySuite and strategic partnerships with local system integrators. A key technical initiative fueling this is our migration to a serverless architecture on AWS Lambda. Our capital expenditures remain tightly managed. Our total capital expenditure for the quarter was $15 million, which is in line with our guidance. Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) remained stable at 45 days. We've also implemented a new invoice automation system that has reduced payment processing times and improved our cash conversion cycle. A portion of our operating cash flow is strategically allocated to Research and Development (R&D).

We anticipate a continued strong FCF performance in Q4, driven by seasonal strength in software spending and the ongoing benefits of our operational efficiency initiatives. We are projecting an FCF of $80-$85 million for Q4, bringing our total FCF for the year to approximately $285 million.

We remain committed to deploying our capital effectively to maximize shareholder value, including investing in product development, sales and marketing to drive continued revenue growth, actively evaluating potential acquisition targets, and evaluating opportunities to return capital to shareholders through share repurchases.

Our Net Revenue Retention for Q3 2023 stands at 118%. Expansion continues to be the primary engine fueling our NRR, with a 25% expansion rate. We are seeing excellent traction with our newly launched "AI-Powered Anomaly Detection" module within our core "Sentinel Insights" platform. A significant portion of our growth comes from customers upgrading to higher subscription tiers. Our "Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response (SOAR)" product, "CycloneSOAR," continues to see strong cross-sell success within our existing customer base. We are witnessing strong expansion in the APAC region.

Contraction remains relatively low at -2%. Our Customer Success team has been instrumental in proactively identifying and addressing potential contraction risks. We are seeing slightly higher contraction rates within our SMB customer segment.

Our churn rate for Q3 is -5%, which is slightly above our target of -4%. The cybersecurity market is becoming increasingly competitive. To combat competitive churn, we are focusing on deepening integrations with key technology partners, are committed to continuous innovation, and are investing in expanding our global support team and improving our response times to address customer issues more effectively. The recent acquisition of "SecureGuard" by "CyberDefense Corp" led to the loss of a few customers in the heavily regulated energy sector.

We have several technical initiatives underway that directly impact NRR, including investing in significant infrastructure upgrades to improve the scalability and performance of our platform, enhancing our APIs to make it easier for customers to integrate our platform with their existing security infrastructure, and a new, streamlined onboarding process, leveraging AI-powered recommendations.

Looking ahead, we remain optimistic about our NRR performance and our ability to execute our strategy, but we are mindful of the current macroeconomic environment.

For Q3 2024, our ACV landed at $85,000, representing a 7% increase year-over-year and a 2% increase sequentially. A significant contributor to the ACV increase is the growing adoption of our premium modules, particularly within our flagship "Synergy Platform." We've seen a 22% increase in customers subscribing to at least two premium modules. We continue to execute our strategy of targeting larger enterprise accounts. We implemented a refined pricing strategy in Q2, shifting towards value-based pricing models that better reflect the ROI our platform delivers. Our Net Revenue Retention (NRR) rate remains strong at 121%.

While our enterprise focus is crucial, we've also increased our investment in the Small and Medium-sized Business (SMB) segment. ACV varies across different geographic regions.

We've made significant investments in enhancing our API infrastructure and platform extensibility. We've implemented a comprehensive data analytics platform that provides us with real-time insights into customer usage patterns and adoption rates.

We will continue to invest in developing innovative features and capabilities for our premium modules. We plan to launch a new "Predictive Maintenance" module for the Synergy Platform in Q4, targeting the industrial sector. We're actively expanding our partner ecosystem to reach new markets and accelerate adoption of our platform. We're continuously refining our sales and marketing strategies to better target the right customers with the right message. We are committed to providing our customers with the best possible experience.

Our capital allocation philosophy centers on a balanced approach that supports both organic growth fueled by internal investments and strategic inorganic growth through targeted acquisitions.

Approximately 60% of our allocated capital this quarter is being directed towards internal investments. We are heavily investing in AI and ML integration, cloud migration & scalability, and new feature development & platform enhancements. We are strategically investing in S&M to drive new customer acquisition and expand our market share, including digital marketing & lead generation, sales team expansion & training, and our channel partner program.

Approximately 30% of our capital is earmarked for strategic acquisitions, focusing on companies that complement our existing product portfolio, expand our market reach, and acqui-hires.

The remaining 10% of our capital is allocated to share repurchases and dividend payouts. We are currently planning a share repurchase program of $7.5 million.

North America remains our largest market. We are seeing increased adoption of our cloud-based solutions in Europe. Asia-Pacific (APAC) is our fastest-growing market.

We are closely monitoring KPIs to assess the effectiveness of our capital allocation strategy, including Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV), Revenue Growth, and Return on Invested Capital (ROIC).

We are updating our full-year guidance to reflect our strong performance in the first half of the year. We now expect revenue to be in the range of $2.7 billion to $2.75 billion.

Now, I'll turn the call over to David Rodriguez for a technology update.

David Rodriguez:
Thank you, Sarah. This quarter, we made significant progress in advancing our AI capabilities and further integrating them into our core platform. We are seeing strong adoption of our new AI-powered features, which are driving increased user engagement and improved customer outcomes. We've also focused on enhancing our platform's security and scalability to meet the growing demands of our enterprise customers.

And now Brian Kim will provide update on product roadmap.

Brian Kim:
Thank you, David. We have been focusing on the user experience of our products and are excited to announce the launch of SynergyAI. This new feature significantly improves project planning and resource allocation by leveraging artificial intelligence. We are seeing strong adoption of this feature which aligns with our product strategy.

Now, I'll turn the call back to the operator for Q&A.

Operator:
Thank you. [Operator Instructions] Our first question comes from John Thompson with Morgan Stanley.

John Thompson:
Hi, good afternoon. Can you discuss the impact of FlowState on your overall growth, what kind of attach rates are you seeing, and how it compares to your initial expectations?

Emily Carter:
FlowState has exceeded our initial expectations, becoming a significant growth driver. We are seeing attach rates of around 30% with our SynergySuite customers, and it's especially popular among enterprises looking to streamline their business processes. This is significantly higher than the 15% attach rate we initially projected, demonstrating the strong demand for low-code automation solutions.

Operator:
Our next question comes from Lisa Miller with Goldman Sachs.

Lisa Miller:
What are your plans for international expansion, specifically in the APAC region, and what are your key target markets?

Michael Lee:
We are aggressively expanding in the APAC region, focusing initially on Australia, Singapore, and Japan. These markets are showing strong demand for our cloud-based solutions and have favorable regulatory environments. We are investing in local sales teams and partnerships to accelerate our growth in these key target markets. Our localized version of SynergySuite, compliant with regional data privacy regulations, is proving to be a significant differentiator.

Operator:
Our next question comes from David Blake with JP Morgan.

David Blake:
How are you managing churn in the current economic environment, what's the trend you are seeing in NRR, and what are your strategies to improve customer retention?

Sarah Chen:
We are proactively managing churn by focusing on customer success and providing value-added services. Our NRR remains strong at 118%, indicating healthy customer retention. To further improve customer retention, we are investing in personalized onboarding, proactive support, and continuous product innovation. We are also closely monitoring customer usage patterns to identify and address potential churn risks before they materialize. We're seeing positive results from offering flexible payment plans to customers facing budget constraints.

Operator:
Thank you. I'm showing no further questions at this time. I'd like to turn the call back over to Michael Lee for closing remarks.

Michael Lee:
Thank you for joining us today. We are pleased with our progress this quarter and remain committed to delivering strong results for our shareholders. We look forward to speaking with you again on our next earnings call.

Operator:
Thank you for your participation. You may now disconnect.
